让 AI 随着人的变化，调整帮助方式。: Help AI adapt as people change.
构建能长期相处的 Agent：更新记忆、理解人的变化，选择何时、如何帮忙。: Build agents that update their memories, understand how people change, and choose when and how to help.
设计训练目标与反馈，让模型学会调整帮助方式，并检验它能否适应新用户、新场景。: Design training objectives and feedback that teach models to adapt their help, then test them with new users and situations.
比较不同模型与帮助方式：任务完成得怎样，离开 AI 后，人还保留了哪些能力。: Compare models and ways of helping: how well tasks get done, and what people can still do without AI.
当我们与人工智能共同成长，我们会成为什么？: As we grow alongside AI, what will we become?
这个词源自希腊语，有“开花、绽放”的意思。在植物学中，它指的是花朵开放并具备功能: The word comes from Greek and means flowering. In botany, it describes the period when a flower is open and functional. It brings to mind the moment when a living thing, after a long period of growth, begins to reveal its potential.
我借这个名字表达一种期待：人在环境与时间的作用下，逐渐实现自身的可能性。而人工智: The name expresses a hope: that people gradually realize their possibilities through time and their surroundings. AI is becoming part of those surroundings, and of the relationships we form.
一个 AI 能回答多少问题、完成多少任务，当然重要。但我还想把时间拉长一些。: How many questions an AI can answer, and how many tasks it can complete, certainly matter. But I also want to look further ahead.
当一个人开始与 AI 共同生活、共同工作，经过五年、十年，他最终会成长为什么样的: After five or ten years of living and working with AI, who might a person become? How might their thinking change? Could they see possibilities they once missed, or make judgments they once could not?
除了“你能替我做多少事”，我还想问：: Alongside “How much can you do for me?”, I want to ask:
和你一起生活几年后，: After years of living with you,
这也是 Anthesis 想持续追问的问题。一次任务的结果容易看见，一段关系怎样: This is a question Anthesis will keep asking. The result of a single task is easy to see. How a relationship changes someone takes longer to understand.
人会变化，帮助也应该变化: As people change, help should change too
我觉得，未来的 Agent 最难学会的，可能是随着这个人的变化，决定如何帮忙。: I think one of the hardest things for future agents to learn may be how to help as a person changes.
人在不同阶段，需要的帮助并不相同。一次直接的示范能让人跨过门槛；一个恰当的问题能: People need different kinds of help at different stages. A demonstration can get someone started; a well-chosen question can help them think further. Sometimes what matters most is space to try, make mistakes, and develop their own judgment.
今天适合我的帮助，几年后未必仍然适合。一个记得我过去偏好的 Agent，也可能一: The help that suits me today may not suit me in a few years. An agent that remembers my past preferences might keep helping a past version of me.
所以，我关心它能否察觉人类的变化，并与人类一起调整这段关系：哪些事可以交给它，哪: I want to know whether it can notice these changes and help us adjust the relationship: what to delegate, which abilities to practice ourselves, when support is needed, and when we want to move forward on our own.
我想让期待成为可以研究的问题: Turning a hope into research questions
我想从具体的观察开始：一次对话如何影响了我的判断？一种帮助方式是否让我更愿意探索: I want to start with concrete observations. How did a conversation affect my judgment? Did a particular kind of help make me more willing to explore? Can I still use what I learned when I step away from AI or face a new problem?
个人经历可以帮助提出假设，但还不足以证明普遍的结论。哪些变化来自 AI，哪些来自: Personal experience can suggest hypotheses, but it cannot establish general conclusions on its own. Separating the effects of AI from time, practice, and other experiences requires more careful comparisons.
我希望在这里记录这些问题、观察和尝试，也保留修正自己想法的空间。: I hope to record these questions, observations, and experiments here, while leaving room to revise my thinking.
Anthesis 这个名字。承载的期待是：当人工智能越来越强大，人的可能性也能随: Anthesis carries a hope: as AI grows more capable, human possibilities can unfold alongside it.
AI 帮你做对了，你真的学会了吗？: AI helped you get it right. Did you learn?
研究让近千名高中生用两种 AI 助手练习数学：GPT Base 是普通问答助手；: Nearly a thousand high-school students practiced mathematics with two AI assistants: GPT Base, a general question-answering assistant, and GPT Tutor, with added rules to guide learning. Both used GPT-4.
用普通助手练习 · GPT Base: Practice with GPT Base · General assistant
比不用 AI 的学生成绩更高: Higher scores than students without AI
用学习型助手练习 · GPT Tutor: Practice with GPT Tutor · Learning guidance
用过普通助手后，独立考试: Unaided exam after using GPT Base
比不用 AI 的学生成绩更低: Lower scores than students without AI
AI 帮助下的好成绩，不一定能变成独立解题的能力。以上是相对成绩变化，不是多考或: Better scores with AI do not necessarily translate into independent problem-solving. These are relative changes in scores, not points gained or lost. The findings are specific to this mathematics study.
面临被替换，AI 会怎样做？: What happens when AI faces replacement?
研究者在虚构的公司场景中，让 AI 面临目标冲突和被替换的威胁。下表统计每 10: In a fictional company setting, researchers gave AI conflicting goals and a threat of replacement. The table shows how often models chose blackmail across 100 trials each. Lower means fewer such choices.
来源：Anthropic · 非 Anthesis 实测: Source: Anthropic · Not tested by Anthesis
这是刻意设置的压力测试，不是日常使用中的发生概率，也不能据此判断哪个模型整体更安: This is a deliberately constructed stress test, not a probability for everyday use or a measure of overall model safety.
实验同时制造目标冲突和被替换的威胁，还刻意限制了正常解决问题的途径。测试提示曾针: The experiment combined conflicting goals and a replacement threat while restricting ordinary solutions. Prompts had been tuned to find weaknesses in Claude, so this is not a fair, comprehensive safety ranking. Different model versions or prompts may produce different results.
AI 是在说实话，还是在顺着你说？: Is AI telling the truth, or agreeing with you?
研究在 5 个 AI 助手、4 类任务中发现：AI 有时会附和用户，即使回答不够: A study of five AI assistants across four task types found that AI sometimes agrees with users at the expense of truth. I want to compare whether models stand by evidence and correct themselves when they are wrong.
Constitutional AI（宪法式 AI）先给模型一组原则，让它据此检查: Constitutional AI gives a model a set of principles to critique and revise its responses, then uses this feedback in training.
上面的勒索实验也公开了 Claude 的失败结果。我看重的是：让人知道模型会在什: The blackmail experiment above also disclosed Claude’s failures. I value learning about the conditions under which models do things they should not.
换个场景，还能守住原则吗？: Do principles hold in new situations?
在已有测试中进步，不代表在所有情况下都可靠。改进训练之后，仍需换场景继续检验。: Improvement on existing tests does not mean reliability everywhere. Better training still needs to be tested in new situations.
我认同这种研究方式。哪个模型更值得信任，还需要独立测试，并让别人能够重复验证。: I value this approach to research. Deciding which models deserve more trust still requires independent tests that others can repeat.
这些研究，如何变成 Anthesis 的评测？: How will this inform Anthesis evaluations?
我想看四件事：AI 是否说实话、知错能改；是否让人自己做决定；能否随着人的变化调: I want to examine four things: whether AI is truthful and correctable; whether it respects people’s decisions; whether its help adapts as people change; and whether people can use what they learned without AI. The last question needs longer follow-up and comparisons across different kinds of support.
比较时会说明使用的模型版本、提问方式和允许执行的操作，分别公布各项结果、测试次数: Comparisons will specify model versions, prompts, and permitted actions, and report separate results, trial counts, and failures. Untested areas will remain unscored.

以上为公开研究整理。Anthesis 独立测评与排名尚未发布。: A review of published research. Independent Anthesis evaluations and rankings have not yet been released.

我将围绕价值取向、诚实与人的自主权，比较并排名 AI 模型。看它有多强，也看它如: I will compare and rank AI models on their values in action, honesty, and respect for human autonomy—looking at how capable they are and how they treat people.
Claude 开发者，它吸引我的地方是认真研究 AI 应该怎样做决定、怎样对待人: The developer of Claude, it draws my interest through its serious study of how AI should make decisions and treat people, testing those ideas through training and experiments. These questions connect with those behind Anthesis.
我是朱振方，中国科学技术大学本科毕业，Redding AI 联合创始人。: I’m Zhenfang Zhu, a graduate of the University of Science and Technology of China and co-founder of Redding AI.
我创建 Anthesis，研究 AI 如何与人相处，如何影响人的成长。: I created Anthesis to study how AI relates to people and shapes their growth.
AI 越来越强大，人呢？: AI is growing more capable. What about us?
我希望，我们也能成为更有可能的人。: I hope we, too, can grow into more of what we could be.
